name: AI Search
description: How generative engines such as ChatGPT search, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Mode find, read, and cite web pages, and what that means for a blog that wants to be one of the cited sources.

name: Technical SEO
description: Rendering, crawlability, structured data, sitemaps, and the parts of a site that decide whether a crawler can read your content at all before anyone argues about the writing.

name: Content Strategy
description: What to write, how to structure it, and how to keep it accurate over time. Covers answer capsules, question headings, internal linking, and the refresh cadence that keeps a post citable.

name: Engineering
description: REPLACE OR DELETE ME. A fourth category exists here to show that the taxonomy is yours. Five to ten fixed categories is the working range; each one is an indexable hub page, so each one needs a real description.
